create_base_options: create a BaseOptions instance to configure argparse arguments for audio-visual experiments
initialize_arguments: initialize the argument parser with dataset paths, GPU IDs, batch size, and audio/video parameters
parse_options: parse command-line arguments and return an options namespace with processed GPU IDs and saved config
configure_gpu_ids: configure GPU IDs from a comma-separated string and set the primary CUDA device
save_options_to_disk: save parsed command-line options to a text file in the experiment checkpoint directory
